notes: «أن الحكيم ... حدثه» and «أن نافع ... حدثاه»: rule 5, each one who told the next is a link; «نافع» and «عبد الله» are two co-transmitters of one level.
«حمران، مولى عثمان بن عفان»: the mawla clause is kept as the name is written; the Companion is the second «عثمان بن عفان» (occurrence 2).
The Prophet's words are the saying; Uthman is the last link.
